function direct(item: { value?: string }) {
  if (item.value) {
    delete item.value;
    console.log(item.value.toUpperCase());
  }
}
function descendant(item: { value?: { name?: string } }) {
  if (item.value?.name) {
    delete item.value;
    return item.value?.name;
  }
}
function computed(item: { value?: string }) {
  if (item.value) {
    delete item["value"];
    const erased: undefined = item.value;
  }
}
function parenthesized(item: { value?: string }) {
  if (item.value) {
    delete (item.value);
    const erased: undefined = item.value;
  }
}
function chain(item: { child?: { value?: string } }) {
  delete item.child?.value;
  if (item.child) {
    const erased: undefined = item.child.value;
    return item.child.value?.toUpperCase();
  }
}
